facts.statement: A Spring special gave players two times the SC when buying Station Cash during April 6-8, 2012.
facts.quote: Get two times the SC when you buy Station Cash® between April 6th and April 8th*!

article_summaries.title: Double Station Cash Spring Fever
article_summaries.summary: A official freerealms.com news post announcing a Spring promotion: purchases of Station Cash (SC) made during a limited window give two times the SC. The post is dated only relatively (posted 1 week, 4 days before capture), so its exact posting date is unknown; the capture date is 2012-04-18.
